review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: velt-comment-sidebar-list-item-v2 wraps customer children in div.velt-sidebar-list-item — the SAME class the SDK's own default row uses. Any unscoped suppression of the default list therefore also hides the composed rows.
learnings.context: strictly primitives, composed sidebar list. Suppressing the default list with an unscoped rule took all 62 composed rows to 0x0 while every assertion on the primitives still passed.
learnings.evidence: Measured live on harvey: composed rows 0x0 after an unscoped default-list suppression; scoping the suppression under our own vc- ancestor restored all 62.

learnings.statement: velt-comment-sidebar-list-v2 APPENDS customer children rather than replacing its own content: its cdk virtual-scroll list renders alongside the composed rows.
learnings.context: strictly primitives, composed sidebar list. Expect a duplicate list unless the SDK's own list is explicitly collapsed.
learnings.evidence: Observed live on harvey during the style stage; the SDK list and the composed rows were present simultaneously.

learnings.statement: R1 REPLACES a primitive's default content. A primitive placed with NO children therefore renders NOTHING — it does not fall back to the SDK's default rendering.
learnings.context: The structure build placed avatar/name/time/message as empty elements, expecting the SDK to fill them. All four rendered nothing across 62 rows, and every structural gate still passed — the defect was invisible until the style stage measured them at 0x0.
learnings.evidence: harvey: velt-comment-dialog-thread-card-avatar/-name/-time/-message measured 0x0 with no text x62; supplying children rendered them correctly.

learnings.statement: velt-comment-dialog-composer-action-button requires type="submit". Without a type it renders nine empty ngIf anchors AND discards the supplied child, so the control is absent rather than merely unstyled.
learnings.context: strictly primitives composer. Twelve candidate type values were probed live on harvey; only 'submit' renders. The manifest does not record this tag's type vocabulary.
learnings.evidence: harvey: no send control at all until type="submit" was set; 12 values probed.

learnings.statement: sync-primitives.mjs mis-attributed 366 of 441 primitives to their -wireframe twin (wrong emitsTag) and 363 to forwardsClassName:true. Two wrappers share each reactName and collide after the -wireframe suffix is stripped; only the wireframe twin __rest-forwards, so the `|| forwards` tiebreak always won. Fixed in this run.
learnings.context: The bug's output had additionally been written into agents/velt-planner-primitives.md and guide/reference/primitives-capabilities.md as an SDK fact ("366 tags are rendered through a -wireframe-suffixed element"). Derived manifest facts need re-checking against the running SDK before they harden into documentation.
learnings.evidence: @veltdev/react 6.0.0-beta.15 esm/index.js:2918 emits the plain tag, :5109 the -wireframe twin; same for composer-input (3815/4433), thread-card-name (2960/5117), thread-card-avatar (2894/5079). After the fix zero primitives record a -wireframe emitsTag.

learnings.statement: A demo whose VeltProvider pins config={{develop:true, version:...}} is on the DEV SDK bundle, and the API key must be the matching dev key. Never resolve an empty comments sidebar by deleting config — that is the symptom of a key/environment MISMATCH, and on the production bundle every composed primitives surface silently renders nothing (children discarded, no error).
learnings.context: Cost this run its first four stages: config was removed to fix an empty sidebar, which moved the run onto the production SDK where R1 is absent. The build was then mis-diagnosed as mode_blocked, and an 'independent' verification re-tested the same wrong environment and confirmed the error.
learnings.evidence: harvey, measured both ways with a React-bypassed marker child: production bundle survivedInside=false/anywhereInDoc=false (host renders its own 7694-byte subtree); dev bundle 6.0.8-beta.3 true/true (host keeps our 385-byte subtree).

learnings.statement: Preflight should run the R1 boot probe BEFORE the structure build, not after. check-primitive-reachability only answers 'does a primitive exist for this surface', never 'does children projection work at runtime', and its documented --velt-version flag is not implemented (exits 2 on a usage error).
learnings.context: The plan correctly recorded the probe as unverified[0] with 'verify before a second surface is built'; it was actually run after all three surfaces were built. A two-minute probe would have replaced forty minutes of work on the wrong environment.
learnings.evidence: harvey run 2026-08-27: reachability gate exit 0 while R1 was absent on the SDK actually loaded.

learnings.statement: Applying setUnstyledMode(true) at the structure stage leaves the host app visibly broken if the run halts before the style stage — there is no restore-on-abort.
learnings.context: Between stage 2 and stage 3 the app renders Velt's stripped base with no replacement. Any halt in that window degrades a working demo.
learnings.evidence: harvey: sidebar rendered unstyled with zero vc-* elements present after the run stopped at structure.
